title: Bucharest long steady + tempo finish
terrain: flat city running, no vert available
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: ~85min total, flat Bucharest terrain. Steady Z2 for the bulk, then a 12min tempo finish at 160-166bpm since there's no vert here to load the climbing muscles.
GYM: none.
FUEL: Tailwind flask if available, else water + one gel at 45min.
STOP RULE: skip the tempo finish if HRV reads amber that morning, extend Z2 instead.
WHY: no mountains in Bucharest, so this becomes the week's volume carrier with a tempo kicker in place of vert.
